description: This file defines a React hook 'useTip' and a 'TipManager' class for managing contextual tips in the Notesnook application. It includes tip data, configuration, and logic for rotating tips based on context.

classes.name: TipManager
classes.description: Manages retrieval and state of tips based on context, including initialization and filtering.

methods.name: useTip
methods.description: React hook that provides a contextual tip, with optional rotation and delay.
